text: In the event that any deliverable is found to incorporate an orphan work—a copyrighted work whose author cannot be identified or located—the Contractor shall replace such work with a licensed alternative within thirty (30) days of discovery and shall compensate the Client for any costs arising from use of the orphan work.
label: intellectual_property

text: The parties agree to a tiered dispute escalation mechanism: (Tier 1) operational-level discussion within ten (10) business days; (Tier 2) executive-level negotiation within a further fifteen (15) business days; (Tier 3) non-binding expert determination for technical disputes; and (Tier 4) binding ICC arbitration for all remaining unresolved disputes.
label: dispute_resolution

text: Technical disputes relating to the conformity of software deliverables with agreed specifications shall be referred to an independent software testing expert jointly appointed by the parties. The expert shall issue a written determination within thirty (30) business days, which shall be binding unless either party demonstrates manifest error within fourteen (14) days of receipt.
label: dispute_resolution

text: Disputes arising under smart contract arrangements recorded on a distributed ledger shall be governed by the on-chain dispute resolution protocol specified in the smart contract code, provided such protocol produces an outcome consistent with the intent of this Agreement. Where the on-chain outcome conflicts with this Agreement, this Agreement shall prevail.
label: dispute_resolution

text: The parties agree that in multi-party construction disputes involving the Owner, General Contractor, and Subcontractor, the dispute resolution mechanism shall operate simultaneously across all related parties to ensure consistent outcomes and to prevent inconsistent arbitral awards arising from parallel proceedings.
label: dispute_resolution

text: In the event of a regulatory investigation triggered by this Agreement, the parties agree that all internal communications exchanged for the purpose of jointly responding to the investigation shall be subject to a common interest privilege, and neither party shall waive that privilege without the other's written consent.
label: dispute_resolution

text: Any claim for loss of profits, loss of business opportunity, or loss of anticipated revenue arising from a breach of this Agreement shall be subject to a mandatory preliminary hearing before a sole arbitrator to assess whether the claim passes a prima facie threshold before full arbitration proceedings are commenced.
label: dispute_resolution

text: The parties agree that any arbitration brought under this Agreement shall be conducted on a documents-only basis for claims below USD 250,000, with no oral hearings permitted. For claims exceeding this threshold, a full hearing may be convened at the seat of arbitration with forty-five (45) days notice.
label: dispute_resolution

text: In international franchise disputes, the parties agree that the arbitration shall be conducted under the WIPO Arbitration Rules, with the arbitrator having authority to order cross-border injunctive relief, appointment of a receiver, or compulsory license of the franchise IP during the pendency of the dispute.
label: dispute_resolution

text: The parties expressly agree that the arbitrator shall have power to issue awards in equity as well as in law, including orders of specific performance, rescission, or declaratory relief, and shall not be limited to monetary compensation in fashioning a remedy.
label: dispute_resolution

text: For disputes arising from fintech partnerships involving payment processing or digital asset management, the parties agree that disputes shall be fast-tracked under an expedited arbitration procedure with a target timeline of ninety (90) days from the filing of a notice of arbitration to the issuance of a final award.
label: dispute_resolution

text: Extreme weather events attributable to climate change, including but not limited to abnormally severe flooding, wildfires, and extended heat emergencies that render performance physically impossible, shall constitute Force Majeure Events under this Agreement. The parties acknowledge that climate-related events are increasing in frequency and agree to review this definition annually.
label: force_majeure

text: Geopolitical disruptions, including sudden imposition of international sanctions, armed conflict at or near a party's principal place of business, or government-ordered closure of key transport corridors, shall constitute Force Majeure Events. The affected party shall provide prompt notice with supporting publicly available evidence and shall explore alternative supply chain routing with documented diligence.
label: force_majeure

text: In semiconductor supply agreements, global chip shortages driven by factory closures, raw material embargoes, or geopolitical export restrictions shall be treated as Force Majeure Events. The Supplier shall allocate available inventory fairly among customers and shall document its allocation methodology as part of its force majeure notification.
label: force_majeure

text: A prolonged power grid failure or electricity rationing program imposed by government authorities that prevents operation of the Contractor's production facilities for more than seventy-two (72) consecutive hours shall constitute a Force Majeure Event, entitling the Contractor to an extension of time equal to the duration of the outage plus a reasonable recommissioning period.
label: force_majeure

text: Ransomware attacks or coordinated DDoS attacks that render a party's IT systems inoperable for more than forty-eight (48) continuous hours shall constitute Force Majeure Events, provided that: (a) the affected party had implemented industry-standard cybersecurity measures; and (b) the attack was not facilitated by the affected party's negligence.
label: force_majeure

text: In pharmaceutical manufacturing agreements, a recall or withdrawal of a key raw material by a regulatory authority on safety grounds, where no alternative-qualified supplier exists with available capacity, shall constitute a Force Majeure Event. The Manufacturer shall document all efforts to qualify alternative suppliers as part of its force majeure obligations.
label: force_majeure

text: Maritime shipping agreements shall treat port closures, canal blockades, piracy events, or extreme weather affecting shipping lanes as Force Majeure Events. In such cases, the Carrier shall use reasonable alternative routing and shall notify the Shipper immediately, providing an estimated delay and revised delivery schedule.
label: force_majeure

text: This Agreement expressly provides that the economic consequences of a Force Majeure Event, including increased costs, inflation, or currency devaluation, shall not of themselves constitute Force Majeure Events. Only direct physical inability to perform shall qualify, unless the parties agree in writing to a hardship adjustment clause.
label: force_majeure

text: In energy sector contracts, a government-mandated curtailment of energy production capacity, renewable certificate withdrawal, or change in grid access rights that materially reduces the producing party's ability to deliver contracted volumes shall be treated as a qualifying Force Majeure Event, subject to regulatory documentation being provided.
label: force_majeure

text: If a Force Majeure Event causes only partial impairment of performance, the affected party shall continue to perform to the extent reasonably possible and shall proportionally allocate available capacity among its contractual commitments using a documented, non-discriminatory methodology.
label: force_majeure

text: In the context of a private equity-backed management buyout, the departing founders agree to a non-compete covering the specific product category, customer segment, and geographic market of the portfolio company for a period of thirty-six (36) months post-closing. In consideration, the founders shall receive a non-compete consideration payment of two percent (2%) of the transaction enterprise value.
label: non_compete

text: The healthcare practitioner consents, as a condition of joining the medical group, to a non-compete applicable within a twenty-mile radius of any clinic operated by the group for a period of twenty-four (24) months post-departure. The practitioner acknowledges that enforcement in this jurisdiction requires the payment of a non-compete allowance per applicable state law.
label: non_compete

text: The digital platform's non-compete clause prohibits the departing senior engineer not only from joining competitors, but also from accepting advisory roles, board seats, or equity participation in any startup that directly replicates core features of the platform's proprietary recommendation algorithm within eighteen (18) months of termination.
label: non_compete

text: In franchise agreements, the franchisee agrees that during the term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after termination, it shall not operate, invest in, or provide consulting services to any business that competes within a five-kilometer radius of any existing franchise location of the same brand, whether operated by the franchisee or any other franchisee.
label: non_compete

text: The non-solicitation provision shall prohibit the departing employee from accepting unsolicited business from former clients if the client's decision to switch is proven to have been influenced by information, relationships, or leveraged pricing intelligence developed during the employee's tenure with the company.
label: non_compete

text: The cross-border employment contract includes a cascading non-compete: twenty-four (24) months globally for C-suite executives; eighteen (18) months within the EMEA region for vice presidents; and twelve (12) months within the country of employment for all other senior employees. Each tier may be enforced independently.
label: non_compete

text: The parties agree that breach of the non-compete clause shall be subject to liquidated damages calculated as one and a half times the employee's last annual total compensation package, reflecting the parties' genuine pre-estimate of the harm caused by competitive activity rather than an unenforceable penalty.
label: non_compete

text: In cloud service reseller agreements, the reseller agrees not to white-label, rebrand, or seek equivalent services from any direct competitor of the cloud provider's platform for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, and shall provide the cloud provider with sixty (60) days advance notice before initiating any competitive procurement process.
label: non_compete

text: The non-compete obligations attached to an M&A transaction shall be enforceable against each of the selling shareholders who receives sale proceeds above a threshold of five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000), as each such shareholder is deemed to have received independent, adequate consideration for the restriction.
label: non_compete

text: The investment advisor non-compete shall prohibit the individual from managing or advising any fund with an investment strategy materially overlapping with that of the fund managed by the firm for a period of twenty-four (24) months. Overlap shall be defined as greater than thirty percent (30%) similarity in portfolio construction as measured by asset class, geography, and sector allocation.
label: non_compete

text: The SaaS provider warrants a monthly system uptime of ninety-nine point nine percent (99.9%), calculated excluding pre-notified maintenance windows of no more than four (4) hours per month. Service credit remedies for downtime shall be calculated on a sliding scale and shall constitute the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for uptime failures.
label: warranties

text: The financial data provider warrants that all market data feeds shall be transmitted with a latency of no greater than five (5) milliseconds under normal operating conditions. Any systematic latency exceeding this threshold for more than thirty (30) consecutive seconds shall be treated as a service warranty breach and shall trigger automated service credit calculations.
label: warranties

text: In pharmaceutical contract manufacturing, the CMO warrants that all batches shall be manufactured in strict compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations, applicable pharmacopoeial standards, and the Product Quality Agreement (PQA) executed simultaneously with this Agreement. Any deviation from the PQA shall be reported within twenty-four (24) hours.
label: warranties

text: The construction contractor warrants that all structural elements shall be designed and built to withstand the loads and environmental conditions specified in the structural engineer's report for a minimum of fifty (50) years, subject to normal maintenance. This structural warranty shall survive project completion and shall be transferable to subsequent owners of the building.
label: warranties

text: The cybersecurity vendor warrants that its managed detection and response (MDR) service shall identify and contain critical security incidents within a mean time to contain (MTTC) of four (4) hours from initial alert. Failure to meet this MTTC on more than two occasions in any calendar quarter shall constitute a material breach of warranty.
label: warranties

text: In AI model licensing agreements, the Licensor warrants that the licensed model's performance metrics, including precision, recall, and F1 score on the agreed benchmark dataset, shall not degrade by more than five percent (5%) relative to the performance disclosed at contract signing for a period of twelve (12) months post-deployment.
label: warranties

text: The medical device manufacturer warrants that its diagnostic device shall maintain accuracy within the clinically acceptable tolerance range as defined by the applicable CE mark or FDA 510(k) clearance for the device's entire intended service life, provided the device is operated and maintained in accordance with the instructions for use.
label: warranties

text: In energy performance contracting, the energy services company (ESCO) warrants a minimum guaranteed energy cost saving of twenty percent (20%) annually relative to the pre-project baseline. If savings fall below this threshold, the ESCO shall make up the shortfall through a performance guarantee payment, calculated as the difference between actual and guaranteed savings.
label: warranties

text: The software integrator warrants that the integrated system shall, upon go-live, process a minimum of ten thousand (10,000) concurrent transactions per second without performance degradation exceeding five percent (5%) of agreed response time benchmarks. Performance warranty claims must be supported by independently verified load testing reports.
label: warranties

text: The hardware vendor warrants that all components supplied under this Agreement conform to RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) and WEEE (Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment) Directive requirements, and undertakes to provide documentation of conformity upon request within five (5) business days.
label: warranties

text: The parties agree to incorporate Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance obligations into this supply chain agreement. The Supplier shall annually submit a third-party verified ESG disclosure report and shall maintain a minimum ESG rating of 'B' as assessed by an internationally recognized ESG rating agency. Failure to maintain this rating may be treated as a contract review trigger.
label: other

text: Each party represents and warrants that it has not made, offered, or authorized, and shall not make, offer, or authorize, any payment, gift, or other inducement to any government official, employee, or business partner for the purpose of obtaining or retaining business in connection with this Agreement, in compliance with the UK Bribery Act 2010, the US FCPA, and all applicable anti-corruption laws.
label: other

text: The parties agree to maintain a joint data governance committee comprising two representatives from each party. The committee shall convene quarterly to review data sharing practices, assess compliance with applicable data laws, and approve any proposed changes to data processing activities conducted under the framework of this Agreement.
label: other

text: This Agreement is self-contained and entire. All prior term sheets, memoranda of understanding, heads of agreement, and letters of intent relating to the subject matter of this Agreement are superseded and have no contractual force. No party may rely upon pre-contractual representations not expressly incorporated herein.
label: other

text: In multi-party consortium agreements, the parties agree to appoint a Consortium Manager who shall be responsible for coordinating the activities of all parties, maintaining a master task register, and convening monthly progress meetings. Decisions of the Consortium requiring unanimous consent shall be made in writing and shall be binding on all members.
label: other

text: The parties agree to conduct an annual contractual compliance audit to verify adherence to the key obligations of this Agreement. The audit shall be performed by a mutually agreed-upon independent auditor, with costs shared equally. Audit findings shall be treated as Confidential Information and shall generate a mandatory remediation plan within sixty (60) days.
label: other

text: For technology supply agreements with critical national infrastructure operators, this Agreement shall include enhanced step-in rights for the relevant government authority, allowing the authority to assume operational control of the services for up to ninety (90) days in the event of a national security incident or critical service disruption.
label: other

text: The parties acknowledge that this Agreement may be subject to mandatory notification to or approval by relevant competition authorities before becoming fully effective. Each party shall file the required notifications promptly and shall cooperate fully with any regulatory review process. The Agreement shall not become effective until all required clearances have been obtained.
label: other

text: In agreements involving indigenous land rights or community benefit sharing, the parties agree that this document shall be accompanied by a Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) protocol document governing the manner in which affected communities are consulted, and any decision by an affected community to withdraw consent shall trigger a mandatory renegotiation of this Agreement.
label: other

text: The parties agree to include a contractual technology modernization clause, requiring the parties to renegotiate pricing, service levels, and technical specifications every three (3) years to reflect material advances in the relevant technology. Either party may trigger a modernization review by providing ninety (90) days written notice.
label: other
